findings.claim: Both plugins claimed loaded by a singular-named live test. Answered: the test loads both (opencode_plugin_live_test.go:39-48 loops over labdrian-runtime-parity and memorycard, failing if either does not load or write its active marker).
Stale-wording substring test is brittle. Answered: intentional guard so the overclaims removed by the verifier do not come back; a reword that trips it is reviewed then.
Subtest name cited as a bare string, unchecked. Answered: the subtest exists (codex_source_test.go:123); a reference format cannot cite subtests, so the name lives in the detail text.
